title: Subject & action
prompt:
Subject & action
An extremely small, solitary astronaut figure standing in the vast, desolate Martian landscape, occupying less than 5% of the total frame height to emphasize overwhelming scale. The figure is positioned in the lower center, evoking profound isolation and existential contemplation.

Composition & framing
Ultra-wide-angle 16mm perspective with a minimalist spatial arrangement. The upper 65% of the frame is dominated by a sweeping, featureless white-hued Martian sky and distant horizon, creating a sense of infinite emptiness. Clear visual stratification between the barren foreground, mid-ground dunes, and the hazy long-range horizon.

Lighting & atmosphere
Soft, diffused overcast lighting creating a low-contrast environment. The air is filled with thin, pervasive fog and fine Martian haze, muting distant details. The color palette is dominated by warm, high-saturation orange and ochre tones contrasted against the pale, bleached sky.

Material & texture
Photorealistic landscape rendering with fine, granular natural textures on the terrain. Subtle Kodak Vision3 500T film grain overlay to enhance the cinematic, poetic quality. The surface exhibits delicate wind-swept ripples and geological erosion patterns.

Visual style
Cinematic landscape photography inspired by the minimalist aesthetic of Christopher Doyle. The scene feels quiet, lonely, and introspective, avoiding hyper-detailed clutter to maintain a serene, far-reaching spatial perspective.

Constraints
No close-range characters, no large subjects, no complex foreground elements. No text, no watermarks, no logos, no oversaturated neon, and no digital artifacts.
